messages.subject: mc-stan.org site down (Tue, 28 July 2015)
parts:
We know mc-stan.org is currently down.

That's because an all-new site is on the way and should be
up as soon as the DNS changes propagate to all the DNS servers.
They think it may be five to seven hours.

- Bob
